title.vi: 1. Private messenger: relay, archive và endpoint trust
title.en: 1. Private messengers: relays, archives and endpoint trust

paragraphs.vi: Bài này xây private person-to-person messenger kiểu WhatsApp với direct/group messages, offline devices, attachments, companions và backups. Chọn store-and-forward server queues thay full server history archive là một design policy, không điều kiện bắt buộc của E2EE: server cũng có thể giữ encrypted history dưới retention/authorization contract khác. Các 12 stages là teaching architecture, không inventory production hiện tại.
paragraphs.en: This lesson builds a WhatsApp-style private person-to-person messenger with direct/group messages, offline devices, attachments, companions and backups. Choosing store-and-forward queues instead of a complete server history archive is a design policy, not a requirement of E2EE: servers can retain encrypted history under different retention/authorization contracts. The 12 stages are a teaching architecture rather than an inventory of a current production system.

paragraphs.vi: Approved endpoints có thể đọc/share/report nội dung; compromised endpoints và user-saved copies nằm ngoài lời hứa chỉ relay ciphertext. Business integrations, bots/AI hoặc reporting paths phải chỉ rõ plaintext endpoint/trust boundary riêng thay suy từ private human chat. Worksheet không generate keys, encrypt hay implement Signal; chỉ kiểm counts, histories và key-possession assumptions.
paragraphs.en: Approved endpoints can read, share or report content. Compromised endpoints and user-saved copies lie outside a promise that intermediaries relay only ciphertext. Business integrations, bots/AI and reporting must declare their own plaintext endpoint/trust boundaries rather than inherit assumptions from private human chat. Worksheets generate no keys, encrypt nothing and do not implement Signal; they examine counts, histories and assumed key possession.

title.vi: 2. Một message có nhiều identities và ACKs
title.en: 2. One message has multiple identities and acknowledgements

paragraphs.vi: Giữ logical message ID bind sender/conversation, immutable envelope identity cho recipient device/generation, membership epoch và accepted-result record. Retry prepared ciphertext dùng retained envelope; legitimate re-encryption có revision mới nhưng vẫn cùng logical intent khi phù hợp protocol. Không tự viết ratchet/state machine từ sơ đồ: outgoing protocol state và persisted envelopes cần audited implementation/recovery để tránh key reuse hoặc lost state.
paragraphs.en: Retain logical message IDs bound to senders/conversations, immutable envelope identities for recipient devices/generations, membership epochs and accepted-result records. Retrying prepared ciphertext preserves its envelope; legitimate re-encryption uses a new revision while retaining logical intent where the protocol permits. Do not invent ratchets/state machines from a diagram: outgoing protocol state and persisted envelopes need audited implementation/recovery to avoid key reuse or lost state.

paragraphs.vi: Server ACK nghĩa selected durability đã nhận obligation; device ACK nghĩa selected local persisted acceptance; read receipt là explicit action/policy. Có thể persist ciphertext rồi chờ key/decrypt theo declared contract, nhưng không gọi nó user read. Server GC chỉ khi exact authenticated device obligation đã hoàn tất hoặc retention transition được ghi rõ.
paragraphs.en: A server acknowledgment means the selected durability boundary accepted an obligation. A device acknowledgment means the selected local persistence boundary accepted it. Reading is a separate explicit action/policy. Ciphertext may be durably stored awaiting keys/decryption under a declared contract, but this is not user reading. Server garbage collection completes only exact authenticated device obligations or explicitly records retention expiry.

title.vi: 3. 12 giai đoạn: scope, scale và trust boundaries
title.en: 3. Twelve stages: scope, scale and trust boundaries

paragraphs.vi: Đọc problem/decision/cost/next trigger/exit criteria. Erlang/lightweight processes là một option cho sockets, không thay admission/backpressure hoặc durability. Historical single-box connection records không là current production capacity/SLO. Privacy và recovery choices phải được giữ khi platform, ownership hoặc device model đổi.
paragraphs.en: Read each pressure, decision, cost, next trigger and exit criterion. Erlang/lightweight processes are one socket-runtime option; they do not replace admission, backpressure or durability. Historical single-machine connection records are not current production capacity/SLOs. Preserve privacy and recovery choices when platforms, ownership or device models change.

description.vi: Erlang/BEAM-style lightweight processes hoặc event loops giúp nhiều sockets nhưng không miễn memory/CPU/kernel buffers. Profile FD/TLS/buffer/heartbeat/scheduler queues, GC và mailbox growth. Per-process crash isolation không isolate shared dependency failure. paragraphs.vi: Lab một message choD1/D2: ACK D1 không cho phép xóa D2 offline queue. Nếu D1 ACK khi chỉ volatile rồi crash, server đã GC và không còn replay path. Nếu D2 persist nhưng ACK lost, redelivery cùng logical identity phải không thêm duplicate local message. Recipient state/result/receipt cần coherent crash recovery; unique ID alone không serialize effects.
paragraphs.en: The lab sends one message to D1/D2: acknowledging D1 cannot delete offline D2 obligations. If D1 acknowledges volatile-only data and then crashes, garbage collection leaves no replay path. If D2 persists but its acknowledgment is lost, redelivery under the same logical identity must not add a duplicate local message. Recipient state/results/receipts need coherent crash recovery; a unique ID alone does not serialize effects.

paragraphs.vi: Per-device queue giữ accepted ciphertext theo retention, storage durability và auth/epoch contracts. Device nhận thiếu key/context có thể giữ durable pending-decrypt và repair request theo protocol; đừng gọi chưa decrypt là read. Queue TTL hết hạn cần expired/failed outcome, push notification chỉ wake hint chứ không durable delivery.
paragraphs.en: Per-device queues retain accepted ciphertext under retention, storage durability and authentication/epoch contracts. Devices missing keys/context may durably retain pending-decryption items and request protocol repair; undecrypted content is not read. Queue TTL expiry needs an expired/failed outcome. Push notifications are wake hints, not durable delivery.

title.vi: 8. Approved identities, metadata và endpoint threat model
title.en: 8. Approved identities, metadata and endpoint threat models

paragraphs.vi: E2EE khác TLS: wire tới service được bảo vệ không đồng nghĩa operator không đọc content. Approved endpoint key ownership, authenticated session setup, per-message evolution, replay/out-of-order bounds và device verification cùng tạo contract. Một malicious directory có thể try introduce device; approvals/consistency/security-code verification cần semantics cụ thể. Không treat public-key fetch là trust proof.
paragraphs.en: E2EE differs from TLS: securing the wire to a service does not prevent that endpoint’s operator from reading content. Approved endpoint-key ownership, authenticated session setup, per-message evolution, bounded replay/out-of-order handling and device verification jointly define the contract. A malicious directory may introduce a device; approval, consistency and security-code verification need concrete semantics. Fetching a public key is not proof of trust.

paragraphs.vi: Metadata vẫn có routing, device/account/group membership, time/size/media access theo design. Encryption không tự anonymous, không chặn authorized recipient share/report hoặc endpoint malware. Cryptographic forward secrecy dưới erased-key assumptions không xóa plaintext history đã lưu ở devices. Private communications, business integrations và backups phải state rõ ai là authorized plaintext endpoint.
paragraphs.en: Depending on the design, routing, device/account/group membership, times, sizes and media access remain metadata. Encryption does not itself provide anonymity or prevent authorized recipients from sharing/reporting or endpoint malware from reading plaintext. Cryptographic forward secrecy under erased-key assumptions does not delete plaintext history saved on devices. Declare authorized plaintext endpoints for private communications, integrations and backups.

title.vi: 9. Sender Keys tối ưu sender, không xóa recipients
title.en: 9. Sender Keys optimize senders, not recipient delivery

paragraphs.vi: Sender phân phối chain state + public signing verification key qua approved pairwise sessions; private signing key không được phát cho group. Payload tiếp theo dùng protocol message-key evolution/erasure và signing rồi relay fan-out. Membership leave cần clear/start fresh theo selected scheme; inactive sender có thể chưa gửi new distribution tới khi next send. Churn và device changes cần per-sender/per-group generations.
paragraphs.en: Senders distribute chain state and public signing-verification keys over approved pairwise sessions; private signing keys are not shared with the group. Subsequent payloads use protocol message-key evolution/erasure and signing before relay fan-out. Member departures require clearing/starting fresh state under the chosen scheme; inactive senders may defer distribution until their next send. Churn/device changes need per-sender/per-group generations.

paragraphs.vi: Cost lab giữ A surviving active senders, mỗi sender M messages mỗi epoch và chỉ non-senders rời group. Ở epoch k cóRk=(N−k)×D−1recipient devices, gồm companions của sender trừ originating device. Pairwise data envelopes=A×M×ΣRk; SenderKey distribution=A×ΣRk, shared payloads=A×M×epochs. Server data deliveries của cả hai vẫn=A×M×ΣRk. Đây là logical counts, không equal-cost crypto benchmark.
paragraphs.en: The cost lab retains A surviving active senders, each sending M messages per epoch, with only non-senders leaving. At epoch k, recipient devices are Rk=(N−k)×D−1, including the sender’s companions but excluding the originating device. Pairwise data envelopes=A×M×ΣRk; Sender Key distribution=A×ΣRk; shared payloads=A×M×epochs. Both schemes retain A×M×ΣRk server data deliveries. These are logical counts, not equal-cost cryptographic benchmarks.

paragraphs.vi: Short/churny conversations có thể chưa amortize setup. Batching packets, ciphertext sizes, key/session establishment, signatures, retries và actual CPU/battery cần measured costs riêng. Full group key-management alternatives có security/scale properties khác; không suy một shared static key là tương đương Sender Keys hoặc mọi group protocol.
paragraphs.en: Short/churny conversations may not amortize setup. Packet batching, ciphertext sizes, key/session establishment, signatures, retries and actual CPU/battery use need separate measurement. Other group-key-management schemes have different security/scaling properties; static shared group keys are not equivalent to Sender Keys or to every group protocol.

title.vi: 10. Membership revoke khác thu hồi old knowledge
title.en: 10. Revocation differs from retracting old knowledge

paragraphs.vi: Lab A/B/C đã đọc và lưu m0; sauBleave,Djoin,currentepoch 2. Fresh sender key được phân phối tới current recipients theo approved sessions. B không nên có future key, nhưng m0 saved không biến mất. D chưa có old history theo selected no-history-sharing policy; explicit authorized history sync có thể là operation khác.
paragraphs.en: In the lab, A/B/C have read and saved m0; B then leaves and D joins at membership epoch 2. Fresh sender keys reach current recipients through approved sessions. B should not receive future keys, but its saved m0 does not disappear. Under the selected no-history-sharing policy, D has no old history; explicit authorized history synchronization is a separate operation.

paragraphs.vi: Nếu sender vẫn dùng old key, server chỉ bỏ B khỏi fan-out chưa bảo vệ cryptographic access nếu B nhận được ciphertext ở nơi khác. Epoch admission giúp reject honest stale-context sends, nhưng metadata label không chứng minh actual cipher dùng đúng key; full protocol/context verification và endpoint assumptions vẫn cần. D missing key có thể cần pending-decrypt/key repair. Compromised current endpoint vẫn được cấp fresh key không được chữa chỉ bằng rotation.
paragraphs.en: If senders retain old keys, removing B from relay fan-out does not prevent cryptographic access when B obtains ciphertext elsewhere. Epoch admission rejects honest stale-context sends, but metadata labels do not attest which key actually encrypted a payload. Full protocol/context verification and endpoint assumptions remain necessary. D may need pending-decryption/key repair. Rotation alone does not cure a compromised current endpoint that continues receiving fresh keys.

paragraphs.vi: Upload ciphertext vào immutable generation, finalize complete blob rồi gửi protected descriptor bound generation/integrity/context. Receiver verify trước output, xử lý missing/expired media qua explicit UI/retry policy. Media URL/access logs không nên lộ content keys; encrypted payload vẫn có size/timing/storage/quota concerns. Thumbnail nếu nhạy cảm cũng phải qua proper protection.
paragraphs.en: Upload ciphertext to immutable generations, finalize complete blobs and send protected descriptors bound to generations, integrity and context. Recipients verify before output and handle missing/expired media through explicit UI/retry policies. Keep content keys out of media URLs/access logs. Encrypted payloads still impose size, timing, storage and quota concerns; sensitive thumbnails need suitable protection too.

paragraphs.vi: Message retained/delivered không bảo đảm media còn tồn tại mãi. Choose message/media retention, deletion/tombstone propagation và orphan cleanup independently; fullsize downloads không đi qua latency-sensitive socket relay. Client-side dedup/hash cũng không tự anonymous hoặc proof content safe; integrity claim dựa authenticated descriptor.
paragraphs.en: Retained/delivered messages do not promise permanent media. Choose message/media retention, deletion/tombstone propagation and orphan cleanup independently. Large downloads bypass latency-sensitive socket relays. Client-side hashes/deduplication do not provide anonymity or prove content safe; integrity depends on authenticated descriptors.

paragraphs.vi: Approved companion không phải alias cùng socket. Mỗi device có own identity/session state, own durable inbox/receipt và relevant outgoing encrypted copies. Directory approval/consistency chống unauthorized additions trong threat model; revoke cần invalidate future contexts/session/bundle view và định nghĩa queued old-envelope handling. Không giả instant erase keys/history trên device đã nhận.
paragraphs.en: Approved companions are not aliases for one socket. Each has distinct identity/session state, durable inboxes/receipts and relevant outgoing encrypted copies. Directory approvals/consistency prevent unauthorized additions under the threat model. Revocation invalidates future contexts/session/bundle views and defines how queued old envelopes are handled; it does not instantly erase received keys/history.

paragraphs.vi: History transfer tới new approved device phải authorized, E2EE và coherent snapshot/delta boundary. History/chats/settings đọc/xóa state có different merge policies; stable event IDs/versions và tombstones chống resurrect deleted state. Local search indexing chạy endpoint hoặc privacy-preserving design có threat model riêng; server không được silently decrypt private archive để làm search.
paragraphs.en: History transfers to newly approved devices must be authorized, E2EE and consistent across snapshot/delta boundaries. Chat history, settings and read/deleted state require different merge policies. Stable event IDs/versions and tombstones prevent deleted-state resurrection. Local search runs at endpoints, or through a privacy-preserving design with its own threat model; servers cannot silently decrypt private archives for search.

title.vi: 13. Backup keys và HSM recovery: phạm vi và giới hạn
title.en: 13. Backup keys and vault recovery: scope and limits

paragraphs.vi: Encrypted backup gồm ciphertext generations/manifests/integrity và selected recovery material. Có thể user-held secret hoặc protected vault/device/password flow; một HSM-based vault có thể giữ secret dưới authenticated protected channel và attempt controls. Vì vậy “mọi key không rời device” hoặc “brute force impossible với mọi operator” là claims quá rộng. State HSM/trusted-code/anti-rollback/limit assumptions và recovery policy.
paragraphs.en: Encrypted backups combine ciphertext generations, manifests, integrity evidence and selected recovery material. Recovery can use user-held secrets or protected vault/device/password flows. An HSM-based vault can retain secrets under authenticated protected channels and attempt controls. Consequently, universal claims that keys never leave devices or brute force is impossible for every operator are too broad. State HSM/trusted-code, anti-rollback, attempt-limit and recovery-policy assumptions.

paragraphs.vi: Restore verify generation/coherence/integrity, authenticate approved recipient device và avoid replay/rollback to revoked authority. Forgotten material/lockout/reset có product-specific recovery rules; đừng suy no-helpdesk guarantee cho mọi mode. Backup retention/erasure khác relay queue GC và user-visible deletion. Test restore under partial/lost device/cloud failure, không chỉ backup upload success.
paragraphs.en: Restores verify generation/coherence/integrity, authenticate approved recipient devices and prevent replay/rollback into revoked authority. Forgotten material, lockout and resets have mode-specific recovery rules; do not infer one universal no-helpdesk guarantee. Backup retention/erasure differs from relay queue garbage collection and user-visible deletion. Test restores with partial data, lost devices and cloud failures rather than only successful uploads.

caption.en: Key recovery, coherent snapshots and device approval are separate requirements. Successful uploads do not establish restorable backups.

paragraphs.vi: Partition owners/session routes cần epochs/fencing/equivalent coordination tại actual write sink. Primary/secondary replication không tự solve split-brain hoặc accepted-data RPO. Backpressure giữ socket mailboxes/queues bounded; per-user/device/group quotas và reconnect jitter tránh shared auth/key-directory overload. Measure availability của accepted delivery nghĩa gì, không chỉ connections up.
paragraphs.en: Partition owners/session routes need epochs, fencing or equivalent coordination at actual write sinks. Primary/secondary replication does not itself solve split-brain or accepted-data RPO. Backpressure bounds socket mailboxes/queues. Per-user/device/group quotas and jittered reconnects avoid shared authentication/key-directory overload. Define and measure availability of accepted delivery, not merely connected sockets.

paragraphs.vi: Migration preserve accepted envelope/result, metadata versions, protocol state và recovery identities. Shadow compares không send real duplicate recipients hoặc expose keys. Logs tối thiểu safe IDs/versions/reasons, không plaintext/private keys/raw sensitive member histories. Group fan-out, key-distribution backlog và missing-key decrypt failures là separate metrics.
paragraphs.en: Migrations preserve accepted envelopes/results, metadata versions, protocol state and recovery identities. Shadow comparisons must not duplicate real recipient effects or expose keys. Logs retain minimal safe IDs, versions and reasons rather than plaintext, private keys or raw sensitive membership histories. Track recipient fan-out, key-distribution backlog and missing-key/decryption failures separately.

title.vi: 16. Worked questions: delivery, encryption và recovery
title.en: 16. Worked questions: delivery, encryption and recovery

paragraphs.vi: Trace một offline direct message, một group epoch change và một restore trước khi chọn deep dive. Các answers là design reasoning với scope đã nêu, không security proof hoặc product guarantees ngoài threat model.
paragraphs.en: Trace one offline direct message, one group epoch transition and one restore before choosing a deep dive. Answers provide design reasoning under the declared scope rather than cryptographic proofs or product guarantees outside its threat model.

question.vi: Server ACK và recipient read có giống nhau?
question.en: Are server acceptance and recipient reading equivalent?

answer.vi: Không. Server ACK hứa selected queue durability; device ACK hứa selected local acceptance; read là explicit signal/policy. Cần bind receipts theo đúng device/envelope. Một companion offline vẫn còn obligation sau phone ACK.
answer.en: No. Server acknowledgment promises selected queue durability; device acknowledgment promises selected local acceptance; reading is a separate explicit signal/policy. Bind receipts to exact devices/envelopes. An offline companion still has a delivery obligation after the phone acknowledges.

question.vi: One ciphertext có nghĩa group cost O(1) hết?
question.en: Does one ciphertext make all group work constant?

answer.vi: Chỉ giảm selected sender payload work sau setup. Pairwise distribution và epoch churn vẫn tốn; server deliveries/egress tăng theo recipient devices. Logical envelope counts không là equal-cost crypto/CPU benchmark.
answer.en: Only selected sender payload work becomes smaller after setup. Pairwise distribution and epoch churn still cost resources; server deliveries/egress scale with recipient devices. Logical envelope counts are not equal-cost cryptographic/CPU benchmarks.

question.vi: Khi B rời group, chỉ bỏ B khỏi server fan-out đã đủ chưa?
question.en: Does removing B from server fan-out suffice?

answer.vi: Không nếu future payload vẫn dùng key B biết và B có thể lấy ciphertext. Cần fresh authenticated sender state và distribution theo protocol. Không thể thu hồi m0 B đã đọc/lưu; rekey cũng không chữa một current endpoint vẫn đang bị compromise.
answer.en: Not when future payloads use a key B knows and B can obtain the ciphertext. Establish fresh authenticated sender state and distribution under the protocol. Previously read/saved m0 cannot be revoked; rekeying also cannot cure a compromised current endpoint that remains authorized.

question.vi: Sender Keys phát private signing key cho recipients?
question.en: Do Sender Keys distribute private signing keys?

answer.vi: Không. Recipients nhận chain state và public verification material qua approved pairwise sessions; private signing key ở sender. Full protocol còn message-key evolution/erasure, context và replay rules. Không tự implement từ một toy lab.
answer.en: No. Recipients receive chain state and public verification material through approved pairwise sessions; private signing keys remain at senders. The complete protocol also defines message-key evolution/erasure, context and replay rules. Do not implement cryptography from a toy lab.

question.vi: E2EE có xóa hết metadata và mọi endpoint risk không?
question.en: Does E2EE eliminate metadata and endpoint risk?

answer.vi: Không. Routing, thời gian, kích thước, device và membership metadata cần controls riêng. Approved recipients có thể share/report; compromised endpoint có thể lộ plaintext. Cần nói rõ directory verification, endpoint trust và backup mode. Có ciphertext không chứng minh anonymous.
answer.en: No. Routing, times, sizes, devices and membership metadata need separate controls. Approved recipients can share/report content; compromised endpoints can expose plaintext. Declare directory verification, endpoint trust and backup modes. Having ciphertext does not establish anonymity.

question.vi: UUID có tự bảo đảm redelivery không tạo duplicate UI không?
question.en: Does a UUID alone provide exactly-once presentation?

answer.vi: Không. Device phải persist dedup/state cùng effect/result và phục hồi coherent trước selected ACK. Logical identity cần bind sender/conversation và recipient-device envelope. Retry đổi payload cần conflict hoặc revision policy; một UUID riêng lẻ không serialize các effects.
answer.en: No. Devices must persist deduplication/state coherently with effects/results and recover before selected acknowledgments. Bind logical identities to senders/conversations and recipient-device envelopes. Changed payload retries need explicit conflicts or revision policies; a UUID alone does not serialize effects.

question.vi: Encrypted backups có nghĩa key không bao giờ rời device?
question.en: Do encrypted backups imply keys never leave devices?

answer.vi: Không với mọi mode. Protected HSM vault có thể giữ recovery secret qua protocol không cho ordinary frontend đọc. Cần state trust/attempt/anti-rollback và recovery policy; không nói hardware làm mọi attack impossible.
answer.en: Not for every mode. A protected HSM vault can retain recovery secrets under a protocol that prevents ordinary frontends from reading them. Declare trust, attempt limits, anti-rollback controls and recovery policies rather than claiming hardware makes all attacks impossible.

question.vi: Primary-secondary pair có tự đủ để chỉ có một writer không?
question.en: Does a primary-secondary pair ensure exclusive writers?

answer.vi: Không. Partition hoặc promotion cần activation, fencing, quorum hoặc equivalent protocol ở actual write sink. Route cache không phải fence. Recovery cũng cần giữ accepted envelope/results theo selected RPO, không chỉ khởi động replacement node.
answer.en: No. Partitions and promotions need activation, fencing, quorums or equivalent coordination at actual write sinks. Routing caches are not fences. Recovery must retain accepted envelopes/results under the selected RPO rather than merely starting replacement nodes.
